## You Need A Dictionary

This package is for exploring how language choices shape meaning and sentiment. Users can analyze sentences, experiment with word substitutions, and visualize the emotional impact of their linguistic decisions.

| [fetch_definition](fetch_definition.qmd#you_need_a_dictionary.fetch_definition) | Module that fetches the definition, synonyms and antonyms of a given word using WordNet. |
| [analyze_sentiment](analyze_sentiment.qmd#you_need_a_dictionary.analyze_sentiment) | Analyze the sentiment of the preprocessed user input. |
